But as per Hanafi salah timetable I still have time for our Zohar salah, as Asar time has not started as per Hanafi timetable. Now my question is what should I do? Do i read the Zohar salah first & then try to join the jamat of Asar which has already started may be the jamat may be over before I complete my Zohar salah. or I directly join the jamat for Asar salah & read my Zohar after that? I am very confused. But this happens only sometimes may be once in 3-4 months. 3561 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 33097 Country: India Title: Can we offer salah in front of wall mounted photographs? Question: Can we offer salah in front of wall mounted photographs? Answer ID: 33097 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1106/932/B=1432) It is makrooh to offer salah in front of photographs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
